input.quote: a. it will perform the Services using reasonable care and skill and in accordance with the applicable Service Option Attachments (which means the degree of knowledge, skill and judgment customarily exercised by members of the applicable profession with respect to work of a similar nature); and that it will provide Customer with competent, fully trained, fully qualified and responsible personnel to perform the Services; and
input.rationale: IBM's warranty in § 5.1 is limited to a "reasonable care and skill" services standard plus corporate authority; there is no conformance warranty for Materials or deliverables, no warranty period and no stated remedy (no repair, replacement, re-performance or refund), and no malicious-code warranty. § 5.4(c) then provides all Materials "AS IS" without warranty of any kind, which effectively swallows the express commitment and approaches the walk-away position. We added a 90-day conformance warranty for Materials/deliverables, a no-malicious-code warranty and a repair/re-perform/refund remedy, and carved the express warranty out of the "AS IS" disclaimer.

proposal.summary: Add a 90-day conformance warranty for Materials/deliverables, a no-malicious-code warranty and a repair/replace/refund remedy in § 5.1, and carve the express warranty out of the § 5.4(c) "AS IS" disclaimer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] IBM's only warranty is a "reasonable care and skill" services standard with no conformance warranty, no warranty period and no stated remedy, and § 5.4(c) then puts all Materials "AS IS", which swallows what little is warranted. We have added a 90-day conformance warranty for Materials and deliverables, a no-malicious-code warranty and a repair/re-perform/refund remedy, and carved the express warranty out of the "AS IS" disclaimer. If 90 days is an issue we can discuss a 30-day period for Services, but we cannot accept deliverables with no conformance warranty or remedy.

ops.text: c. for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each Material and other deliverable provided by IBM under this Agreement will conform in all material respects to its applicable documentation and specifications; and d. the Materials and Services will not contain any virus, worm, time bomb or other malicious code introduced by IBM. Customer's remedy for breach of the warranties in this Section 5.1 is, at IBM's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Material or deliverable, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services, Material or deliverable.

ops.newText: c. EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN SECTION 5.1, IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES
